subject: reasoning
question: Geeta starts from Point P and drives 6 km towards south. Then, she takes a right turn, drives 8 km, turns right again and drives 10 km. She then takes a right turn and drives 12 km. Then, she takes a left turn and drives 2 km; she takes a left turn again and drives 4 km and stops at Point Q. How far (shortest distance) and towards which direction should she drive in order to reach Point P again? (All turns are 90-degree turns only, unless specified.)
solution:
Geeta starts from Point P and drives 6 km towards the south.

 
• Then, she takes a right turn, drives 8 km, turns right again and drives 10 km.
 
• She then takes a right turn and drives 12 km.
 
• Then, she takes a left turn and drives 2 km;
 
• she takes a left turn again and drives 4 km and stops at Point Q.
